name: UDSM ARIS 3 v1.4.2
body:
## Home fixes: registration status works + data loads at login

- Hero registration status fixed for real accounts (navbar academic year now surfaced via core 0.3.3) — REGISTERED / PARTIALLY REGISTERED / NOT REGISTERED / GRADUATED / DISCONTINUED instead of a permanent dash.
- Dashboard data (profile + results) loads during login, cached for the session — the hero card opens fully populated and tab switches no longer show placeholders.
- Failed profile sync shows an explicit pull-to-refresh state instead of reading as NOT REGISTERED.
